questions.question: On this day in 1179, which monarch was crowned King of France, later becoming the first ruler to adopt that official styling instead of 'King of the Franks'?
questions.explanation: Philip II, known as Philip Augustus, was crowned in 1179 and from 1190 chose the royal title 'King of France'.
questions.context:
On this day in 1179: Philip II is crowned King of France.
Philip II of France (King of France from 1180 to 1223): Philip II, also known as Philip Augustus, was King of France from 1180 to 1223. His predecessors had been known as kings of the Franks, but from 1190 onward, Philip became the first French monarch to style himself "King of France".

questions.question: Who stars alongside Anne Hathaway and Dakota Johnson in the 2026 psychological thriller film Verity, directed by Michael Showalter?
questions.explanation: Michael Showalter's adaptation of the Colleen Hoover novel features Josh Hartnett in a leading role with Anne Hathaway and Dakota Johnson.
questions.context: Verity (film) (2026 film by Michael Showalter): Verity is a 2026 American erotic psychological thriller film directed by Michael Showalter, written by Nick Antosca, and based on Colleen Hoover's 2018 novel. The film stars Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, and Josh Hartnett.

questions.question: Which ancient Celtic celebration, observed around 1 November, marked the end of the harvest and the start of winter?
questions.explanation: Samhain is a Gaelic festival celebrating the transition into the darker half of the year and marking the start of winter.
questions.context: Samhain (Gaelic festival marking the start of winter): Samhain or Sauin is a Gaelic festival on 1 November marking the end of the harvest season in autumn and beginning of winter or the "darker half" of the year. It is also the Irish and Scottish Gaelic name for November. Celebrations began on the evening of 31 October, since the Celtic day began and ended at sunset. The festival originated in Ireland and it was widely observed throughout Ireland, Scotland, and the Isle of Man. Its Brittonic Celtic equivalent is called Calan Gaeaf in Wales.

questions.question: Which Mexican boxer captured the World Boxing Council super-middleweight belt in October 2026, adding to his titles across four divisions?
questions.explanation: Santos Saúl 'Canelo' Álvarez has held world championships in four weight divisions, including claiming the WBC super-middleweight belt in October 2026.
questions.context: Canelo Álvarez (Mexican boxer (born 1990)): Santos Saúl "Canelo" Álvarez Barragán is a Mexican professional boxer. He has held multiple world championships in four weight classes, from light middleweight to light heavyweight, including unified titles in three of those weight classes. He has held the World Boxing Council (WBC) super middleweight title since October 2026.

questions.question: Which American businesswoman established the diagnostic start-up Theranos in 2003, promoting blood testing with minimal sample sizes?
questions.explanation: Elizabeth Holmes founded Theranos in 2003, gaining notoriety before being convicted of fraud.
questions.context: Elizabeth Holmes (American businesswoman (born 1984)): Elizabeth Anne Holmes is an American businesswoman convicted of fraud in connection with her health technology company Theranos. Holmes founded Theranos in 2003, and its valuation soared in the early 2010s after it claimed to have revolutionized blood testing by developing methods that needed only very small volumes of blood, such as from a fingerprick.
